integrity: The proof is analytic for every number of leaves and every admissible contact probability. A finite exact-component enumerator independently checks special cases; it does not replace the proof. Source novelty has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: One uniformly random seed, undirected star with homogeneous independent open edges, and indicators of eventual infection. Does not claim identical behavior for shared-infectious-period Markov SIR, finite-time infection status, other graphs, or multiple introductions. Existing equivalent result under network reliability language remains a priority risk.
title: A two-scale covariance sign diagram for random-source epidemics on stars
